intervals.note: No source consulted gives the institute's founding date; the start is borrowed from the experiment's first measurements (1985) and is a lower bound for hosting, not a founding date. Open because the institute is listed on the 2017 papers.
intervals.quote: The corresponding measurements were done from 1985 to 2005 [24, 25] and the final results of these efforts were published in [19].

summary.plain: The Moscow-region site of the Institute for Nuclear Research, where the Troitsk nu-mass experiment weighed the neutrino from tritium decay.
summary.technical: INR RAS facility at Troitsk hosting the Troitsk nu-mass tritium beta-decay programme (windowless gaseous tritium source, integrating electrostatic spectrometer).
